definitions: The act of establishing or creating something, such as a business, system, or organisation.
The process of assembling or arranging equipment or apparatus for use.
The act of preparing something for operation or use.
The act of tricking or framing someone.
examples: They are setting up a new branch in Manchester.
He was busy setting up the projector for the presentation.
The team is setting up the experiment.
I think he's setting up his rival to take the fall.
pastTenses: set up (past simple), set up (past perfect)
